name: PLUMB floor-pricing workflow
data: synthetic only (src/sim.py); no real ad-stack data

steps.what: synthetic world: auction with floor, events, free-text ops notes
daily revenue per 1k requests and floor per placement (cell)
OLS quadratic fit of revenue vs ln(floor/current), 21-day window; returns proposed floor, gain, standard error
reads ops notes, returns trust plan JSON {hold_reason, exclude_last, window, direction, step_scale, evidence, strength}; never writes a price
applies plan deterministically: data-quality gates, confidence-scaled step capped at +/-0.25 log
ops accepts, holds or overrides; refusals return to ops with the reason
closed loop, common random numbers, 60-day burn-in, days 60-179, cluster bootstrap; gates tuned on world 1 dev cells, scored on fresh world 2
simulates the pilot plan: matched pairs, shadow week, DiD lift, harm vs control, override rate, A/A false-positive rate
